title: Filter the dashboard by branch, period and currency
summary: See the Dashboard for a single branch, for another period or in another currency.

inputs.branch: Branch name, or Consolidated for all

steps.title: Menu → Dashboard
steps.details: The Dashboard is the clinic's home screen.

steps.title: Choose the branch
steps.details: Consolidated adds up every branch. With a branch chosen, the whole dashboard shows only that one; collections stay consolidated because payments don't record a branch.

steps.title: Open the period
steps.details: The period changes Branches, Best-selling services and Patients per day. Today, month to date and the trend don't depend on it.

steps.title: Choose the period
steps.details: Today, this week, this month, last month, this year or a custom range with From and To.

steps.title: Currency
steps.details: Shows every amount in the chosen currency. Only appears if the clinic works with more than one currency.
